lines.zh: 我沿着神殿的石柱游一圈。
lines.en: I circle the temple's stone pillars.

lines.zh: 我的刺贴着水，像一排短荆棘。
lines.en: My spines trail through the water like short thorns.

lines.zh: 神殿的守卫看见我，会让路。
lines.en: The temple's guards see me and make way.

lines.zh: 我们五条一起绕过海晶灯。
lines.en: The five of us round the sea lantern together.

lines.zh: 我在深处游，水压贴着我的鳞。
lines.en: I swim deep, and the pressure hugs my scales.

lines.zh: 石砖上有苔，我用身体擦过去。
lines.en: Moss grows on the bricks and I brush along it.

lines.zh: 我比守卫慢，也比它们温和。
lines.en: I am slower than the guards, and gentler.

lines.zh: 水流从神殿门里出来，我逆着走。
lines.en: Water pours from the temple gate and I swim against it.

lines.zh: 我的祖先守过这里，我也守着。
lines.en: My ancestors guarded here, and so do I.

lines.zh: 刺划过水面，只留下细纹。
lines.en: My spines cross the water and leave fine lines.

lines.zh: 我们排成一线，穿过长长的走廊。
lines.en: We form a line and cross the long corridor.

lines.zh: 深海的光是蓝的，照得刺也蓝。
lines.en: Deep light is blue, and it makes my spines blue.

lines.zh: 我绕开那些会发光的方块。
lines.en: I steer clear of the glowing blocks.

lines.zh: 神殿很大，我们只是小小的影子。
lines.en: The temple is vast; we are only small shadows.

lines.zh: 我沿着海晶石的缝往里游。
lines.en: I follow the seam of prismarine inward.

lines.zh: 守卫的光扫过我，我照旧走。
lines.en: Guardian light sweeps me; I keep going.

lines.zh: 我们贴着神殿的地面走。
lines.en: We skim the temple floor.

lines.zh: 水流从背后推我，我顺着去。
lines.en: The current pushes my back; I let it.

lines.zh: 我悬在石柱旁，刺微微张开。
lines.en: I hover by a pillar with my spines half open.

lines.zh: 海晶灯亮着，我们都不说话。
lines.en: The lantern glows and none of us speaks.

lines.zh: 深处没有浪，只有很沉的水。
lines.en: No waves this deep, only heavy water.

lines.zh: 我记住每一块砖的位置。
lines.en: I know where every brick sits.

lines.zh: 守卫从我身边游过，没停。
lines.en: A guard swims past me without stopping.

lines.zh: 我的刺是软的，只是看着凶。
lines.en: My spines are soft; they only look fierce.

lines.zh: 这里安静得像一块石头。
lines.en: It is as quiet here as a stone.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆尾，水就慢慢转。
lines.en: I beat my tail slowly and the water turns.

lines.zh: 神殿会一直在，我不着急。
lines.en: The temple will last; I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我望着门口那片更深的蓝。
lines.en: I look at the deeper blue beyond the gate.

lines.zh: 同伴贴着我，刺碰着刺。
lines.en: My schoolmates press close, spine against spine.

lines.zh: 我们五条，就是这片水域的全部。
lines.en: The five of us are all this water holds.

lines.zh: 我合上刺，安静一会儿。
lines.en: I fold my spines and rest a moment.

lines.zh: 地板上的水纹，一圈都没有动。
lines.en: The ripples on the floor have not stirred once.

lines.zh: 你带着水肺下来，我看得出。
lines.en: You came down with water breathing; I can tell.

lines.zh: 很少有活物游到神殿门口。
lines.en: Few living things swim to the temple gate.

lines.zh: 你不像守卫，也不像鱼。
lines.en: You are not a guard, and not a fish.

lines.zh: 我绕着你看了两圈。
lines.en: I circle you twice to look.

lines.zh: 我的刺立起来了，是不由自主的。
lines.en: My spines rise on their own.

lines.zh: 你手里有镐，我不喜欢那种光。
lines.en: You hold a pick and I dislike that shine.

lines.zh: 你退后，我就把刺放下。
lines.en: Step back and I will lower my spines.

lines.zh: 祖先会驱赶你，我不会。
lines.en: My ancestors would drive you off; I will not.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，才决定不动手。
lines.en: I watch you a long time before deciding not to strike.

lines.zh: 神殿的石砖认识你的脚步。
lines.en: The temple bricks know the sound of your steps.

lines.zh: 有人用三叉戟戳了我。
lines.en: Someone jabbed me with a trident.

lines.zh: 我的刺断了两根，很疼。
lines.en: Two of my spines are broken, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 五滴血，我能撑一会儿。
lines.en: Five points of health; I can hold a while.

lines.zh: 我缩起刺，退到柱子后。
lines.en: I draw in my spines and retreat behind a pillar.

lines.zh: 血流进深海，很快就淡了。
lines.en: My blood leaks into the deep and fades fast.

lines.zh: 我没还手，这是温和的习惯。
lines.en: I do not strike back; gentleness is my habit.

lines.zh: 你打得很准，正好在刺缝里。
lines.en: You hit cleanly, right between my spines.

lines.zh: 神殿的石缝里，我缩了一下。
lines.en: I flinch into a crack of the temple stone.

lines.zh: 我往神殿深处退，那里更暗。
lines.en: I retreat deeper into the temple, where it is darker.

lines.zh: 疼，可我不想惊动守卫。
lines.en: It hurts, but I will not alarm the guards.

lines.zh: 你放的饵沉到石砖上。
lines.en: Your bait settles onto the stone bricks.

lines.zh: 我不吃那个，可我有点好奇。
lines.en: I do not eat that, but I am curious.

lines.zh: 我往下压了一点，很慢。
lines.en: I sink a little lower, very slowly.

lines.zh: 守卫从不喂我们，你是第一个。
lines.en: The guards never fed us; you are the first.

lines.zh: 刺在身前挡着，我探不出头。
lines.en: My spines guard the front, so I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 那味道很陌生，像陆地上的东西。
lines.en: The smell is strange, like something from land.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，又想起自己吃什么。
lines.en: I open my mouth, then recall what I eat.

lines.zh: 同伴们都不敢先动。
lines.en: None of my schoolmates dares move first.

lines.zh: 你把手伸得很近。
lines.en: You reach your hand in closer.

lines.zh: 我碰了一下，然后退开了。
lines.en: I touch it once, then pull away.

lines.zh: 你撞上石柱，灰落了我一身。
lines.en: You hit a pillar and dust settles on me.

lines.zh: 我的刺撞到你，你却没受伤。
lines.en: My spines hit you, and you are unhurt.

lines.zh: 我们五条挤在一起，刺互相卡住。
lines.en: The five of us crowd and our spines catch.

lines.zh: 你踩在石砖上，声音很响。
lines.en: You step on the bricks and it rings loudly.

lines.zh: 我让开，可神殿的路太窄。
lines.en: I give way, but the temple path is narrow.

lines.zh: 水被搅起来，灯影全乱了。
lines.en: The water stirs and every lantern shadow breaks.

lines.zh: 别推，我们的刺会断。
lines.en: Do not push; our spines will snap.

lines.zh: 我一碰就往旁边滑，很笨。
lines.en: One touch and I slide aside, clumsily.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我们才敢散开。
lines.en: You step back before we dare scatter.

lines.zh: 这条走廊容不下你和我们五个。
lines.en: This corridor cannot hold you and all five of us.

lines.zh: 我绕着它，把刺一根根张开。
lines.en: I circle it, opening my spines one by one.

lines.zh: 它的刺比我的短一点。
lines.en: Its spines are a little shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排浮在石柱之间。
lines.en: We float side by side between the pillars.

lines.zh: 神殿的光落下来，正好照着我们。
lines.en: The temple light falls right on the two of us.

lines.zh: 我们不急，这里的时间很慢。
lines.en: We are in no hurry; time moves slowly here.

lines.zh: 它用刺碰我的刺，我就懂了。
lines.en: It touches spine to spine and I understand.

lines.zh: 别的同伴在远处守着。
lines.en: The other schoolmates keep watch farther off.

lines.zh: 我们找了个没有水流的地方。
lines.en: We find a place where the current is still.

lines.zh: 祖先也这样，一代一代。
lines.en: Our ancestors did this, generation after generation.

lines.zh: 这一季，深海比平时亮。
lines.en: This season the deep is brighter than usual.

lines.zh: 桶扣下来，神殿一下就没了。
lines.en: The bucket closes and the temple is gone.

lines.zh: 我缩起刺，铁皮太冷。
lines.en: I draw my spines in; the tin is too cold.

lines.zh: 桶里没有水压，我很难受。
lines.en: There is no pressure in here, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 同伴在上面看着我被提走。
lines.en: My schoolmates watch me lifted away.

lines.zh: 五条只剩四条，神殿会空一块。
lines.en: Five become four, and the temple feels emptier.

lines.zh: 我拍桶壁，声音闷闷的。
lines.en: I strike the tin and the sound is muffled.

lines.zh: 你把我晃了一下，刺全散了。
lines.en: One shake from you and my spines splay out.

lines.zh: 那里很亮，我不喜欢亮。
lines.en: It is bright out there and I dislike bright.

lines.zh: 深海的蓝，我大概回不去了。
lines.en: I will likely never return to that deep blue.

lines.zh: 我安静下来，比鱼还安静。
lines.en: I go quiet, quieter than any fish.

lines.zh: 有活的游进了神殿的范围。
lines.en: Something living has swum into the temple's reach.

lines.zh: 守卫先转过头，我也转。
lines.en: A guard turns first, and I turn as well.

lines.zh: 那条鱼在啃石砖上的苔。
lines.en: That fish is grazing the moss on the bricks.

lines.zh: 我认出了它，是能吃的小东西。
lines.en: I know it now: a small thing we can eat.

lines.zh: 光线变了，说明有东西挡着。
lines.en: The light changed, so something is in the way.

lines.zh: 我们五条同时朝那边看。
lines.en: All five of us look the same way.

lines.zh: 我不该吃它，可我还是盯住了。
lines.en: I should not eat it, yet I keep watching.

lines.zh: 它的动作太慢，很容易。
lines.en: It moves too slowly to be difficult.

lines.zh: 我压低了刺，准备过去。
lines.en: I flatten my spines and prepare to move.

lines.zh: 目标不大，我一个人就够。
lines.en: The target is small; I am enough alone.

lines.zh: 我绕着它，刺朝外张着。
lines.en: I circle it with my spines bared outward.

lines.zh: 它退到石柱后面，我绕过去。
lines.en: It backs behind a pillar and I go around.

lines.zh: 我们不咬，我们先围。
lines.en: We do not bite; first we surround it.

lines.zh: 它一碰我的刺就缩了。
lines.en: It touches my spines and shrinks back.

lines.zh: 水压帮我把它困在角落。
lines.en: The pressure helps me pin it in the corner.

lines.zh: 我离得很近，却还不急。
lines.en: I am close now, but still unhurried.

lines.zh: 它想往上游，上面有同伴。
lines.en: It tries to rise, where my schoolmates wait.

lines.zh: 我数着它的呼吸，很乱。
lines.en: I count its breathing; it is all wrong.

lines.zh: 再收一圈，就完事了。
lines.en: One more turn and it is finished.

lines.zh: 神殿见惯了这种事。
lines.en: The temple has seen this many times.

lines.zh: 我用刺划过去，很深。
lines.en: I rake with my spines, and it cuts deep.

lines.zh: 它流了血，水味变了。
lines.en: It bleeds and the water changes taste.

lines.zh: 五条一起扎，它挡不住。
lines.en: Five of us strike and it cannot block.

lines.zh: 我咬得比祖先轻。
lines.en: I bite more gently than my ancestors did.

lines.zh: 这一下，我只用了半力。
lines.en: I put only half my strength into that.

lines.zh: 它甩尾打中我的刺，很疼。
lines.en: Its tail hits my spines, and that hurts.

lines.zh: 我们轮流上前，不乱。
lines.en: We take turns advancing, never in disorder.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，很慢。
lines.en: The blood spreads slowly through the water.

lines.zh: 我退回去，让别人来。
lines.en: I fall back and let another take my place.

lines.zh: 打完了，神殿还是很静。
lines.en: It is over, and the temple is still quiet.

lines.zh: 我在神殿外圈的石缝里醒来。
lines.en: I wake in a crevice on the temple's outer ring.

lines.zh: 四面都是深海的蓝，没有边。
lines.en: Deep blue surrounds me on every side.

lines.zh: 四条同伴等着我，一共五条。
lines.en: Four schoolmates wait for me; that makes five.

lines.zh: 光从海晶灯里渗出来。
lines.en: Light seeps out of the sea lanterns.

lines.zh: 我的刺一出生就是张开的。
lines.en: My spines were open from birth.

lines.zh: 这里离我祖先守的门很近。
lines.en: I am near the gate my ancestors kept.

lines.zh: 水很重，我一下就习惯了。
lines.en: The water is heavy, and I am used to it.

lines.zh: 我们排好队，往神殿里游。
lines.en: We fall into line and swim into the temple.

lines.zh: 守卫看了我们一眼，走开了。
lines.en: A guard looks at us once and moves on.

lines.zh: 我摆了一下刺，算是问好。
lines.en: I flex my spines as a kind of greeting.

lines.zh: 水在烧，我的刺都卷了。
lines.en: The water burns and my spines curl.

lines.zh: 我从石阶上被冲下去，来不及摆尾。
lines.en: I am washed off the steps before I can right myself.

lines.zh: 我在这里活了一辈子，却憋住了气。
lines.en: I have lived here all my life, yet I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 一声巨响，石砖碎成了很多块。
lines.en: A blast shatters the bricks into countless pieces.

lines.zh: 鱼叉扎穿了我的刺，很沉。
lines.en: A harpoon punches through my spines and hangs there.

lines.zh: 紫色的光把我钉在石砖上。
lines.en: Purple light nails me to the bricks.

lines.zh: 神殿里没有苔，我饿了很久。
lines.en: The temple has no moss and I have hungered long.

lines.zh: 雷打穿了水，神殿震了一下。
lines.en: Lightning pierces the water and the temple shakes once.

lines.zh: 神殿底下什么都没有，我在落。
lines.en: Nothing is beneath the temple and I am falling.
